title.zh: Bitcoin Core 32 enters final testing with faster validation, fee changes and security fixes
title.en: Bitcoin Core 32 enters final testing with faster validation, fee changes and security fixes

current_state.zh: Bitcoin Core 32 has entered final testing with changes to transaction fee estimation and block processing, plus a fix for a wallet flaw that could allow an authenticated user to execute commands on a node.
